basics.name: Abishake Arulmani
basics.label: Full Stack Developer / Data Analyst
basics.summary: Versatile Developer and Data Analyst with over 2 years of experience building high-performance web applications and fintech solutions. Currently contributing to Zoho Japan's Online Marketing operations, leveraging AI and automation to streamline business logic. Proficient in the JavaScript ecosystem (React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS) and backend languages like Go, with a strong foundation in SQL and data-driven optimization.

Architected an automated notification system via email and SMS providing daily business statistics and growth metrics.
